## Where it belongs

This project has a house rule: **policy is declarative, rules are Apex, decoupling is
events, volume is Batch, latency is Queueable, the clock is Schedulable.** Which of
these is this?

- [ ] A scoring rule or threshold change (Custom Metadata, no deployment)
- [ ] A notification or feed policy (Flow)
- [ ] A business rule (Apex, with a unit test)
- [ ] New configuration on the Command Center (LWC + Jest test)
- [ ] Something else
